fields.System.Title: CNT-102 — ABC classification of products
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want products classified by value and movement, so that
counting effort concentrates on the stock where errors cost most.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given movement history and stock value, then each product is assigned class A, B, or C.
  • - Given the classification job, then it re-runs on a schedule as patterns change.
  • - Given a product, then its class can be overridden manually with a reason.
  • - Given a class, then its count frequency is configurable — for example A monthly, B
  • quarterly, C yearly.
  • - Given a newly created product, then it defaults to a configured class rather than
  • being unclassified.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, masterdata, inventory |
| Tables | product, count classification |
| Risks | Unclassified products never counted |
| Tests | unit · integration |
